summary: Completed read-only exploration of the inventaris module: mapped 24 Inertia React pages, shared inventaris-search-input component, Blade label-print view, routes in web.php, and SIMRS-backed models. Documented current workflows (catalog, audit checklist, QR labels, photo proxy/upload, master CRUD, ticket asset linking) and identified operational gaps for a hospital inventory system without proposing dbsimrs database writes.
current_status: Inventaris frontend is a functional fixed-asset catalog with room audit (localStorage), QR label printing, photo management, master data CRUD, and ticket integration. Missing operational modules include persisted stock opname, asset transfer/peminjaman, calibration/PM, procurement, disposal, scanner UI, analytics dashboard, and inventaris-specific authorization.
